panels.title: Swap Usage
panels.description: Linux and macOS name their swap metrics differently; each target `or`s both, so exactly one side answers on any given host. Empty means swap is off.

panels.title: CPU Temperature
panels.description: Linux: hottest hwmon CPU sensor (coretemp/k10temp/cpu_thermal). On macOS this needs a helper — Apple publishes die temperature only through IOReport or root-only powermetrics. Install `smctemp` or `macmon` (see dashboard/README.md) and it fills in within 15s. Empty here is expected, not a fault.

panels.title: Disk Temperature
panels.description: NVMe / SATA drive temperature. Linux only — macOS and Windows expose no disk sensor without a third-party helper.

panels.title: GPU Temperature
panels.description: NVIDIA GPUs report this directly. On macOS this needs a helper — Apple publishes die temperature only through IOReport or root-only powermetrics. Install `smctemp` or `macmon` (see dashboard/README.md) and it fills in within 15s. Empty here is expected, not a fault.

panels.title: Battery Temperature
panels.description: macOS laptops only (AppleSmartBattery). Tracks chassis heat rather than the CPU die, so it moves slowly — good for 'is this machine cooking?', not for catching a short load spike.

panels.title: CPU Temperature (package & per-core)
panels.description: Package and per-core temperatures (Intel coretemp / AMD k10temp / ARM). Linux only.

targets.expr: node_hwmon_temp_celsius * on(chip,sensor) group_left(label) node_hwmon_sensor_label * on(chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"coretemp|k10temp|cpu_thermal"}

panels.title: Disk Temperature
panels.description: NVMe (nvme) and SATA (drivetemp) drive temperatures. Linux only.

targets.expr: node_hwmon_temp_celsius * on(chip,sensor) group_left(label) node_hwmon_sensor_label * on(chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{chip_name=~"nvme|drivetemp"}

panels.title: Other Sensors — ACPI zone / chipset / Wifi radio / Mac battery
panels.description: Linux: ACPI thermal zones — CPU package (x86_pkg_temp), chassis (acpitz), Wifi radio (iwlwifi). macOS: battery temperature, plus CPU/GPU die temperatures when smctemp or macmon is installed (Apple publishes no die temperature without one).

panels.title: GPU — NVIDIA (down if no NVIDIA card / exporter)
GPU Utilization — device / renderer / tiler
panels.description: IOAccelerator PerformanceStatistics. 'device' is overall busy time; 'renderer' and 'tiler' are the two halves of Apple's tile-based pipeline. Apple exposes no per-process GPU split without sudo.

panels.title: GPU Memory
panels.description: Apple GPUs share system memory, so this is a slice of RAM, not dedicated VRAM. 'allocated' is reserved, 'in use' is live.
